notes.title: Glass Masquerade 3 release
notes.notes:
Our special thanks to everyone, who shared their feedback during past release days, for helping Onyx Lute with adjusting the game for the player's needs, and also being patient while waiting for the hot fixes. And, of course, reading your reviews, either short or long, was a great pleasure for us, devs - thanks for your support!

For those, who already have wishlisted the game and missed it's release date - it is out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1536980

notes.title: Patch 2.0.1-2.04
notes.notes:
First of all, we want to say GREAT THANKS for all of your support to Onyx Lute, it's SO MUCH appreciated! - we really-really tried to do our best on providing new charming glass experience for your eyes joy and pleasure despite we didn't reach everyone with how it looks and feels

Here is a cumulative list of major changes which were introduced during the last days after release. The next patches are planned a couple of weeks later with some new QoL changes, including various monitor aspects support

Steam
- Steam market assets are now finally live!
- Per-puzzle achievements are now granted for completing puzzles in any difficulty mode
- Added exclusive achievements for hard difficulty walkthrough, which are given for completing every arm of the illusions world map
- For both modes, achievements should be automatically granted correspondingly for already completed content when once entering the game

Gameplay
- Slightly reduced number of fragments for the first 5 puzzles
- Added an option to invert input for puzzle wheels scrolling
- Added an option to invert input for pieces rotation
- Puzzle pieces now can be rotated via A & D keyboard keys on high difficulty
- Fragments with red rings are now rotatable in high difficulty mode, however, they still have a correct rotation on initial drag to avoid guessing

Localization
- Added Italian, Spanish & Portuguese translations
- Fixed minor localization typo-errors and world wrapping issues

Critical
- Fixed a rare issue when save files become corrupted. For those who already have been affected by this problem, please ping to support@onyxlute.com, so we can help with restoring your progress
